optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Index

## Rules

- Signature: `specd graph index [--force] [--exclude-path <pattern>] [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`; `--config` and `--path` mutually exclusive.
- Execute indexing through `runIndexProjectGraph(ctx, input)` in `@specd/sdk`; `--force` passes `force: true`.
- CLI owns parent shared lock, worker isolation (`child_process.spawn`), `onProgress` text output, signals (`SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`), exit propagation. `SPECD_GRAPH_INDEX_NO_WORKER=true` bypasses worker for tests.
- Visible incompatibility repair: delegates provider-owned repair through `runIndexProjectGraph`. Text reports when destructive full rebuild occurred and reason; JSON/TOON expose rebuild flag and reason code.
- Text summary reports indexed count/duration, discovered, documents, skipped, removed, specs, error count/details, plus per-workspace breakdown when present.
- JSON/TOON emit full `IndexResult` including `documentsIndexed` and per-workspace breakdown.
- Lock contention or infrastructure error exits 3 with retry message; per-file errors remain in `IndexResult.errors` and exit 0.
- Documentation in `docs/cli/cli-reference.md` under `## graph` covers all flags, `--exclude-path` gitignore merging, replace semantics, bootstrap, and `graph.*` config fields.

## Constraints

- CLI never assembles workspace/VCS/index inputs inline.
- Lock and worker isolation remain CLI adapter concerns.
- Platform symbols come from `@specd/sdk`.
- Call `process.exit(0)` after provider close.
